Summary: Structural brief sentence attributes ambient field co-presence to the resolved subject (spec section 17 divergence)
Description: 1) Original intent: per spec-field-signal-vs-entity-attribution.md section 17 and AC-11, field-level intensity must not use entity-level wording (convergence, relationship, formation) unless entity attribution is established; the resolved case is field -> attributed evidence -> admitted relationships -> formation only if earned. 2) Acceptance criteria: the brief summary sentence states the two levels separately. Field level: how many domain pairs are co-present across how many live signals, worded as field-level and not as the subject's relationships. Subject level: the subject-bound observation count and the canonical relationship count (when present), or a stated absence. For an unresolved subject the existing no-subject wording is kept. The same sentence is used by the left column and the MAP panel (one function). Exact final wording is to be supplied by the Founder (small changes expected); this ticket is not buildable until the wording has no TBD (section 10). 3) Current implementation state: structuralbrief.jsx (computeBriefSummary, line ~172 area) produces 'The structural relationship around <subject> spans N of 6 domains (...): K admitted cross-domain relationships across M live signals.' K is the count of fieldFormation.graph.edges, an ambient field value that the MAP itself labels 'not bound to the resolved subject'. Observed 2026-10-06 on NVIDIA: 15 admitted cross-domain relationships across 170 live signals, while subject-bound observations were 13 and canonical relationships were 4. The sentence was written 2026-09-28 (KRYL-1332), before section 17 (2026-10-05). The MAP panel now shows the same sentence (KRYL-1368, fb7304f), so the contradiction is visible on one screen. 4) Dependencies: Founder wording; computeBriefSummary in structuralbrief.jsx (shared by left column and MAP); related KRYL-1358 (AC-11 header), KRYL-1343 (co-presence labeled not admitted rho in the left column list), KRYL-1368. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none known. 6) Maps to current product model: yes (section 17, Formation Is Not A Verdict section 21). Classification: spec/implementation divergence (Class C); Founder ruled 2026-10-06 that the spec governs (option 2: split field-level from subject-level).
